body:

No open anchor for this wave; the nearest anchors (#21060, #21735, #21797, #22017) are closed 17.x waves, and #24465 is a single-item re-author. #24567 already carries three rows of this wave (`platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` acceptance[2], `access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report` acceptance[1], the drop-gate prescription) and is not repeated here.

## 1. Re-point — red rows this anchor owns (each needs an edit to turn green)

| `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18` acceptance[2] | #24545 | stale spec — by ruling the runtime PUT door does not judge CEL root scope | the `record.x` / `user.id` arms expect 200; the gate run also flags the clause's "PUT 422" wording as too broad |
| `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code` acceptance[2] | #24541 | assertion defect — under a composite unique index `details` carries no single `field` | assert the composite shape; acceptance[1] of the same item is the product defect #24561 |

The approvals act-door clause (PUT 405 → 404 by design) is #24543.

## 2. Wave-wide themes (apply to many items)

- **18.0 refuses every walled posture** (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated` / `group` → `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). The walled legs can only be proven by pin; record that in `knownGaps` or split them to `planned`: `walled-environment-metadata-operator-only`, `activation-write-operator-gate`, `grant-table-write-contract`, `parent-and-organization-write-guards`, `settings-organization-isolation`.
- **18.0 permits no second organization**, so org-switch clauses are unrunnable on a stock boot (same treatment).
- **The organization-ownership command is withdrawn**; every clause that drives it is `skipped` with the ruling cited.
- **Pins that cover no full clause** (Tier 1 in name only): `calendar-interactions`, `grid-personalization`, `lookup-picker-create-new`, the objectui half of `action-param-widgets` — plus the 9 not-run items in #24571 / #24572 / #24573 / #24574 / #24575's handovers. Either extend the pin or drop `automated` so the next sweep drives them by hand.
- **objectui live e2e is not green at its own pin `4016370a`**: 7 specs are stale and `user-filters` uses pre-ADR-0053 metadata; `studio-object-designer.spec` F1/F4 are red. Items citing those specs as `automated.ref` cannot be satisfied by them today.

## 3. Checklist-accuracy findings (by area — the full list is the "Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps" section of each record)

- **platform-core (#24557):** `builtin-apps` Setup has 42 leaves (not 45) with groups collapsed by default; `settings-hub` code is `value_domain`; `notification-center` polls via the data API and the Approvals tab is count + link; `docs-audience-gate` knownGaps[0] is half stale and acceptance[3]'s subset wording does not hold for permission-set books; `manifest-install` `NamespaceConflictError` now carries a code; `deployment-tables` is 5 tables, not 7; `url-overlay` — the `useUrlOverlay` test asserts no history behaviour.
- **access-security (#24559):** `sharing-rules-widen` §A13 — the seed no longer carries `sys_sharing_rule` rows, test the activation switch across a restart; `record-share-grant-revoke` acceptance[6] — a declarative rule's id is its name; `activation-ledger-row-contract` has a fifth writer (`sharing_rule`); `scope-depth-asymmetry` — the steps' `subject` field does not exist and the pin tests another depth axis; `fls` steps[5] — stock `client_liaison` already satisfies it; `anonymous-floor` knownGaps[1] is stale.
- **attachments-storage (#24560):** `orphan-reap` `automated.ref` omits `attachment-lifecycle.test.ts`.
- **identity-auth (#24538):** `self-service-profile-password` knownGaps is wrong — `import-users` (`passwordPolicy: none`) + impersonate drives the password-less branch without an IdP; the `api-key` item's `source` cites stale `apiMethods` (now get/list/update); `org-membership` — rename changes the record header, not the nav label; `self-signup` hint copy changed; `invitation-scope-gates` needs only a single-tenant boot; `auth-gate` MFA hold has a ~70 s cache delay.
- **approvals (#24542):** `request-page` step 2 body key is `comment`, not `body`; `automated.ref` omits `request-read-gate.integration.test.ts`; c2 is unreachable on stock showcase (a non-admin cannot read `sys_approval_request`); `per-group` c3 should be phrased as run status + request status; `account-app-entry` should state the invoice owner is a text email field and the locale-switch path; `__resolvedFrom` / `autoApproved` are not on the approvals read API.
- **i18n (#24553):** `flow-copy` step 2 needs `os i18n extract --no-objects-only`; the tenant locale route is `/api/settings/localization` (no `/v1`); the bundle has no zh placeholder sample.
- **ai (#24540):** `get_record` takes `recordId`; the object toggle is `enable.apiEnabled`; a skill PUT must carry `tools: []`; DCR needs `application_type: native`.
- **api-backend (#24541) · cli (#24551) · automation (#24545):** ~40 rows — stale "no pin" statements, moved routes and paths, steps missing fixture preconditions. `automation.trigger-status-contract` 409 `RESUME_IN_PROGRESS` was not reached; `automation.connector-degraded-recovery` verify says "reload resets backoff" — only a config-signature change does.
- **integration-system (#24575):** the datasource matrix knownGap "no Postgres recipe" is stale — the recipe is in #24575.
- **studio-authoring (#24571) · records-forms (#24572):** `record-page-roundtrip` acceptance[3] is blocked by the `isDefault` record page `showcase_invoice` ships — use `showcase_contact`.
- **dashboards (#24573) · search (#24574):** the combo `series[]` step; `console-global-search` ⌘K toggle wording, and "张" is below `minLength`; `notify` assignee must be a user id; the `job` timeout probe needs a `retryPolicy`.
- **ux-conventions (#24570):** the expected-FAIL rows in knownGaps no longer reproduce — objectstack-ai/objectui#12690, objectstack-ai/objectui#12303, objectstack-ai/objectui#12691, objectstack-ai/objectui#12693 (a)(b).
- **since:v18 / P0 (#24556, #24558 first comment):** `serve-composition-v18`'s verify recipe omits `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly` (`serve-organization-record-page.e2e.test.ts` is nightly-tier and runs zero tests without it); `save-door` spec refusals carry no rule id.

## 4. Fixture gaps and partial coverage (parked here)

- No IdP / device-flow host / localhost OIDC IdP (`identity-auth.auth-method-matrix` c0/c4, `implicit-account-linking` c1).
- No IMAP test double (mailbox items), no reachable Postgres by default (#24575 shows a local Postgres 16 recipe), no v17 SQLite fixture, no pre-retire `^18` artefact.
- Marketplace upstream needs outbound egress (502 in the sandbox); no HTTP path marks an email verified; a second org on a single-org boot needs a system write; no `controlled_by_parent` scenario (child-object master member can read, not edit).
- No RFC1918 address in the container (`ai` oauth step 4 not run).
- `automation.trigger-status-contract` 503 is `blocked(fixture)`; `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` acceptance[5] member cell is blocked by the still-open maintainer question in its knownGaps[2].
- **Partials:** 47 area items + 12 gate items are `partial`; each record names the unconsulted clauses. records-forms carries 19 — the largest pin-upgrade candidate.
- **Not-run handover:** 64 Tier 3 items (deferred by plan) + 9 Tier 1 items with clause-free pins, named in each record's handover list.

## 5. Extracted elsewhere (not repeated here)

Product defects: #24546, #24547, #24548, #24561, #24562, #24563, #24564 (authorization — detail withheld pending maintainer), #24565, #24576, objectstack-ai/objectui#13052, objectstack-ai/objectui#13054, objectstack-ai/objectui#13055, objectstack-ai/objectui#13056. Test-fix / family: #24543, #24567.

## 6. Runner environment facts (for RUNNER's "Environment facts" table)

- In one container, never run `pnpm build` and `pnpm objectui:build` concurrently — they race on the spec DTS. Under the ~13.4 GB cgroup the objectui dependency build needs `--concurrency=2`, and Tier 1 vitest needs `--maxWorkers=1` (OOM kills with exit 137 otherwise).
- RUNNER names `@playwright/test` 1.62.1; the tree now resolves 1.63.0.
- `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` `classifySelector` reads only a bare area name as an area — a record titled `area:X` lands in "other" (older records such as #23926 too). This wave's titles use the bare form. Behind the repo-scoped egress proxy, qa-rollup's second page via `/repositories/{id}` answers 403.

## 7. Residuals for the maintainer (not defects)

- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals`: the refusal tells the operator to keep the database on 17.x, but the refused v18 boot has already applied the additive v18 schema.
- #24547 may need a ruling: fix the active-save path, or exempt the direct-store door under ADR-0129.
- Observed, not filed (no declared contract): an admin can attach `sys_attachment` to a non-existent parent; RestServer's `/meta/object` refusal uses the flat envelope where the dispatcher wraps it (both ADR-0112-legal); invite-member `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` carries no code; `sys_invitation` stays pending after the invited sign-up; MCP stdio lists 9 tools vs 12 over HTTP; a PATCH that writes the masked datasource literal back is accepted.
